glo4.scope: The Assumption is defined in §44; §§26–27 describe typological scriptural applications, including Ark, Psalm, Canticles and woman clothed with sun. Not proof that these texts literally narrate the event.

glo5.scope: Queenship of Mary is Catholic teaching attested by tradition, liturgy and theology; vision in Apocalypse 12 is typological rather than a ceremony report.
